result.title: Subspace Representations for Synthetic-to-Real Transfer in 3-D Surface Inspection
result.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the ACCV 2026 Workshop on Subspaces in the Era of Foundation Models. Website: https://abdullah-nasir-chowdhury.github.io/projects/accv2026/
result.summary: This paper studies what subspace representations contribute to synthetic-to-real transfer in 3-D surface inspection, where models learn from synthetic defects and the only real data before deployment are scans of good parts. We use three classical constructions as instruments: the nearest-subspace classifier, one-class template subspaces and the generalized difference subspace (GDS). On 1,197 MVTec 3D-AD scans without target annotation we find that every decision rule ranks real defects at a similar window AUC, that image-level detection stays at chance, and that no rule keeps its in-domain threshold. We show that the margin of a nearest-subspace rule moves by at most the part of the feature shift outside its class subspaces, and that this leakage, measured from unlabeled good scans, bounds the displacement observed on unseen scans. On 597 Real3D-AD objects, a one-class subspace of registered templates evaluated at every location on frozen features reaches point AUROC 0.957 on pre-registered scans and a category-mean object AUROC of 78 to 81 with no training on the benchmark. Our results suggest that a subspace helps under shift in proportion to the shift it spans, and that in reference-based inspection the reference and its registration matter more than the subspace.

AI.brief_summary: 研究子空间表示在3-D表面检测合成到真实迁移中的作用：以最近子空间分类器、单类模板子空间和广义差子空间为工具，在MVTec 3D-AD与Real3D-AD上评估无目标标注下的缺陷检测与阈值稳定性，并提出特征漂移中落在类子空间之外的“泄漏”量可界定未见扫描上的位移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「子空间外泄漏」刻画的是表示中未被保留的信息成分，可能为度量 latent 状态对任务必要视觉证据的保留与丢失、以及参考式证据筛选提供几何工具，但研究对象是3D工业检测，与VLM推理期状态生成无直接联系，仅供核查。
